description: Exact-amount EVM approve + action (+ optional revoke) unsigned transaction bundle planner across 8 EVM chains: checks current allowance, balance, gas price, and sequential nonces; never requests unlimited approval and never touches private keys. $0.004 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

actionData.description: optional 0x hex calldata for the spender action transaction

actionValueWei.description: optional non-negative integer wei value for the spender action transaction

amount.description: token spend amount in human decimal units (or integer atomic base units with atomic=1)

atomic.description: set "1" when amount is already in integer atomic base units

chain.description: ethereum, base (default), arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, arc or robinhood

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

revokeAfter.description: set "1" to append a post-action approve(spender, 0) revocation tx

spender.description: contract address to approve and call (0x + 40 hex)

name: tx_bundle_plan
title: Tx bundle plan
